RMSG01.name: Main guideline: accept generic, return specific
RMSG01.meaning: Core API design guideline: accept the most generic type that still supports what the method needs, and return the most specific useful type so callers keep richer capabilities; object/pet/dog diagram and leaky abstraction counterexample.

RMSG02.name: .NET generic/collection hierarchy and immutable collection consequence
RMSG02.meaning: C#/.NET grounding for the guideline: covariance/contravariance and collection interface hierarchy, plus the practical guideline that returned collections should be immutable to avoid copying and whole classes of errors.
